title: Delicious Weeknight Pregnancy Menus: 5 Cook-Once Recipes
excerpt: Five flavorful recipes for busy evenings — soup, stir-fry, egg dishes and yogurt parfaits — balanced for protein, fiber and calcium.
content:
## Introduction
When pregnant, eating a balanced and nutritious diet is crucial for both the mother's and baby's health. However, with busy lives, many pregnant women struggle to prepare healthy and delicious meals. In this article, we will introduce 5 cook-once recipes that provide pregnant women with nutritious and tasty dinners.

## Nutrient Analysis
The recipes below are designed to provide adequate protein, fiber, and calcium for pregnant women. Protein helps build and repair body tissues, while fiber supports digestive health and calcium helps develop the baby's bones and teeth.

## 5 Cook-Once Recipes
### 1. Chicken and Potato Soup
Chicken and potato soup is a simple and nutritious meal. To cook, you need:
- 1 chicken (about 1.5 kg)
- 2-3 potatoes
- 1 onion
- 2 cloves of garlic
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of pepper
- 2 tablespoons of olive oil

Cook the chicken and potatoes in chicken broth, add onion and garlic. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

### 2. Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
Beef and broccoli stir-fry is a great option for dinner. To cook, you need:
- 200g beef
- 1 bunch of broccoli
- 2 cloves of garlic
- 1 tablespoon of olive oil
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of pepper

Stir-fry the beef and broccoli in olive oil, add garlic and season with salt and pepper to taste.

### 3. Fried Eggs with Toast
Fried eggs with toast is a simple and delicious option. To cook, you need:
- 2 eggs
- 2 slices of bread
- 1 tablespoon of butter
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of pepper

Fry the eggs in a pan, add butter and season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve with toasted bread.

### 4. Yogurt Parfait with Fruit
Yogurt parfait with fruit is a great option for a light dinner. To cook, you need:
- 1 cup of yogurt
- 1 cup of fruit (strawberries, bananas, oranges)
- 1 tablespoon of walnuts
- 1 tablespoon of honey

Mix the yogurt with fruit, add walnuts and honey.

### 5. Chicken and Rice with Lemon Leaves
Chicken and rice with lemon leaves is a traditional Vietnamese dish. To cook, you need:
- 1 chicken (about 1.5 kg)
- 2 cups of rice
- 2 lemon leaves
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of pepper
- 2 tablespoons of olive oil

Cook the chicken and rice in chicken broth, add lemon leaves and season with salt and pepper to taste.

## Practical Tips
- Always choose fresh and clean ingredients.
- Cook food at the right temperature to avoid food poisoning.
- Eat a balanced and varied diet to ensure adequate nutrition.
- Consult our [meal planner](/planner) for a personalized eating plan.

## When to Seek Help
If you have any questions or concerns about your diet during pregnancy, consult your doctor or a registered dietitian.
